method.naive: row -> split on '|' -> take cell 1 -> split on '/' and require exactly 2 slash-parts (assumes 'ID Title / SRC-nn:Lxxx') -> split part0 on whitespace -> require exactly one token fullmatching SEAM-\d{2}. Rows whose slash-part arity != 2 are rejected outright.
method.robust: line anchored: optional blockquote/list marker, optional '|', optional bold, then FIRST inline SEAM-(\d{2}) occurrence anywhere in the line (slash-safe).
method.naive_whitespace_only: audit control: pure whitespace tokenizer with fullmatch SEAM-\d{2}, no '/' delimiter

naive_undercount.cause: 斜線標題使 token 切分失敗
naive_undercount.cause_detail: SEAM-09 的標題 'Replay/stale' 使該列 cell 的 '/' 分段由 2 變 3，slash-first 解析器判定該列結構不符而丟棄；robust 以行首錨定抓行內第一個 SEAM-(\d{2})，不受標題內斜線影響。
naive_undercount.note: 僅按空白切 token 而不把 '/' 當分隔符時可數到 11；低估只發生在把 '/' 視為欄位分隔（即 'ID Title / SRC-nn:Lxxx' 欄位假設）的解析器，此即 A-02 描述者。

evidence_rows.rule: one anchor row per unique id (line of first occurrence), UTF-8 byte offsets
